product_overview: EduReach is a public college marketing website that lets visitors explore campus information, programs, mentors, and placements from a single homepage. It also includes a floating help-desk chatbot for asking questions about admissions, fees, courses, and campus life.
core_goals: Present college information clearly on a single homepage
Let visitors jump to About, Courses, Mentors, Campus, and Placements sections
Provide a chat assistant connected to the backend chat endpoint
Allow visitors to use the public content without logging in

features.name: Homepage Marketing Content
features.description: A single-page homepage that presents EduReach branding and key college information, including campus highlights, achievements, courses, mentors, student life, events, and hiring statistics.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View the hero welcome content and campus branding -> Scroll through the about section -> Scroll through achievements, courses, mentors, student life, events, and hiring stats -> Reach the footer
Navigate to / -> View the hero welcome content and campus branding -> Select Explore Programs -> Jump to the courses section -> Continue exploring the remaining homepage sections

features.name: Sticky Navbar Navigation
features.description: A persistent top navigation that helps visitors move around the homepage sections and access the visual login and sign up actions.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Click the EduReach logo -> Stay on the home page -> Click Home, About, Courses, Mentors, Campus, and Placements links -> Jump to the corresponding sections on the page
Navigate to / -> Open the mobile menu -> View the available section links -> Close the mobile menu
Navigate to / -> Click Login or Sign Up -> Remain on the homepage without starting an authentication flow

features.name: Help Desk Chat
features.description: A floating help-desk chat experience that opens a conversation drawer where visitors can read the welcome message, use quick questions, or send custom questions to the EduReach Bot.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Click the floating chat button -> Open the chat drawer -> Read the welcome bot message -> Click a quick question chip -> See the bot reply
Navigate to / -> Click the floating chat button -> Open the chat drawer -> Type a custom question -> Send the message -> See the user message and a bot response
Navigate to / -> Click the floating chat button -> Open the chat drawer -> Minimize the chat drawer -> Expand it again -> Continue the conversation
Navigate to / -> Click the floating chat button -> Open the chat drawer -> Close the chat drawer -> Return to the homepage

routes.description: College marketing homepage with hero, about, courses, mentors, campus, placements, and a floating help-desk chat

features.name: Homepage Marketing Content
features.description: Single-page college site showing campus hero, about stats, achievements, courses, quotes, mentors, student life, events, and hiring stats
user_interactions: View hero welcome content and campus image
Click Explore Programs to jump to courses section
Scroll through about, achievements, courses, mentors, campus, and placements

features.name: Navbar Navigation
features.description: Sticky header with logo, section links, and desktop/mobile login and sign up buttons
user_interactions: Click EduReach logo to stay on home
Click Home, About, Courses, Mentors, Campus, Placements links
Click Login and Sign Up buttons
Open and close mobile hamburger menu

features.name: Help Desk Chat
features.description: Floating chat button opens EduReach Bot drawer to ask college questions via backend chat API
user_interactions: Click floating chat button to open drawer
Type a custom question and send
Minimize or close the chat drawer

known_limitations.issue: Login and Sign Up navbar buttons are UI-only and do not navigate or authenticate
known_limitations.impact: Auth buttons have no routes, forms, or API calls

known_limitations.issue: ChatDrawer message list uses a dummy ref object instead of a real React ref
known_limitations.impact: New messages may not auto-scroll into view

known_limitations.issue: Unknown routes only redirect to home
